FOCI Fiber Optic Communications.why: Supplies fiber array units and silicon-photonics packaging for co-packaged optics plus fiber jumpers for data-center optics; its stated long-term goal is to be a main supplier of CPO fiber array units, with an automated FAU line due for mass production in 2026, so CPO and AI optical build-outs drive its revenue.
FOCI Fiber Optic Communications.evidence: FOCI 2025 annual report: business includes silicon-photonics packaging (SiPh package) and Co-Packaged Optics FAU components and services; long-term goal to become a main and important supplier of CPO fiber array units; 79.61% of 2025 sales to the Americas.

players.product: Fiber array units (FAU) and silicon-photonics / co-packaged optics (CPO) optical packaging services, plus MPO fiber jumpers and passive optical components

quarterly_data.quarter: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CPO strategy: the company's long-term goal is to become a main and important supplier of CPO fiber array units, offering a one-stop FAU, packaging and testing solution; it is building a high-precision automated silicon-photonics FAU production line in Taiwan (floor reinforcement and cleanroom done in 2025) with mass production expected in 2026, is setting up a new plant in Thailand, and will build dedicated lines for customers' volume production. Its silicon-photonics packaging unit is co-developing products and processes with international majors

quarterly_data.quarter: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman (letter to shareholders): the company has gained a key position in silicon-photonics packaging and is developing AI optical products with international customers; 2026 will be a key year for its silicon-photonics packaging products to reach the international stage

quarterly_data.quarter: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D: 2025 R&D expense NT$212,250 thousand (11.22% of revenue); developed 2D fiber array precision-aligned co-packaging and automated silicon-photonics component packaging in 2025, after the ReLFACon reflow-capable lensed fiber array connector (2023) and multi-dimensional lensed fiber array co-packaging (2024); holds core CPO technology and patents in high-density, high-precision fiber arrays
